description: Add a new tool to the MCP server that enables users to create new projects on Shuttle. This tool should integrate with the existing MCP tool infrastructure and provide a clean interface for project creation operations.
functional_requirements: Implement a `project_create` tool that accepts necessary parameters for creating a new Shuttle project
Integrate the tool with the existing MCP tool registration system alongside deployment and logs tools
Handle project creation API calls to Shuttle with appropriate error handling and response formatting
Ensure the tool follows the same architectural patterns as existing MCP tools for consistency
